title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The quiet player
hook: Which player on your team have you heard the least from?
intro: One player never asks a question.
They do the drills and go home.
statement: Quiet does not mean everything is fine.
q1: Do you check in with quiet players one on one —
q2: or give them space and let them open up?
q3: What does that player enjoy most about the team?
t1: Every player is different. But quiet kids open up
t2: when they know you noticed them.
cta: Coaches — how do you reach quiet players?
ctaLines: A quick question at water break. A small job. A nod.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Which player on your team have you heard the least from?
One player never asks a question. They do the drills and go home.
Quiet does not mean everything is fine.
Check in or give them space. There is no single right way.
How do you reach quiet players? Share your habit in the comments.
